div.p: I have got specimens of English Hops from a Kentish gentleman with a long account of their differences and cultivation, which I will send you by another opportunity – as I have not time to pack them properly now.
It seems we have no Hops without grains in Kent, and I confess I think the name must be a false one or that they never came from England – nor do I think they can be so strong as others.
At all events before next spring, I can get you roots of what are considered the best Hops here if you wish for them.
Were Sir T[homas] Acland’s Kentish or Devonshire Hops?

closer.salute:
In great haste
Your faithful ob[edien]t Ser[van]t
